_experiment.description: Lazarevich 2021 baseline: use real unlabelled calibration images (x_test) as Omega instead of uniform random noise. Same prune/adjust algorithm as the manifold baseline. Any difference in the sparsity/accuracy trajectory isolates the effect of the Omega distribution. Run via: python -m sparsifier.lazarevich_sparsifier experiments/e08_omega_data.json
literature: Lazarevich et al. 2021 (layer-wise calibration): uses a small unlabelled calibration set to reconstruct each layer — the direct data-using baseline this experiment compares against
Thesis sec:discussion: explicitly claims data-free operation as a strength — this experiment is the empirical test of that claim
